reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Provision of essential malaria prevention and treatment services in Niger - Niger (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Niger, Malaria, Catholic Relief Services - United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (CRS Niger)This program has the following goals: By 2021, significantly reduce the malaria burden as part of public health improvement efforts. The objectives of this program are: By 2021, reduce the malaria-related mortality rate by at least 40 percent compared with 2015 levels. By 2021, reduce the malaria incidence rate by at least 40 percent compared with 2015 levels
